sentences.en: A planned centrifuge science facility also is in jeopardy.

sentences.en: After reflux the sample was cooled on ice and centrifuged at 1500 g for 15 minutes.
sentences.vi: Sau khi hồi lưu mẫu được làm lạnh trên đá và ly tâm ở 1500 g trong 15 phút.

sentences.en: After incubation, tubes were centrifuged at 1000 g and the supernatant separated from the pellet.

sentences.en: Sedimenting particles in the horizontal-head centrifuge must travel the entire length of the liquid in the tube.

sentences.en: A modern founder would probably use a centrifuge for such a complicated casting.

sentences.en: Additionally, when a horizontal-head centrifuge stops. the tubes fall from the horizontal to the vertical position.
sentences.vi: Ngoài ra, khi máy ly tâm đầu ngang dừng. các ống rơi từ phương ngang sang phương thẳng đứng.

sentences.en: It swung open easily into the vacuum, and he stepped out into the now silent centrifuge.

sentences.en: Buildings can be seen that may be associated with two techniques for uranium production: gas centrifuge and laser separation.
